title: Local finite presentation over bounded-image condensed algebraic-closure coefficients is local freeness
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers] and an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with its extended $\ell$-adic norm [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is noetherian (every ascending chain of opens stabilizes), with the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. On profinite sets with the finite jointly surjective topology define $\underline\Omega(S)$ to be the continuous functions $S\to\Omega$ whose image is contained in one finite intermediate field $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], with pointwise ring operations and restriction by precomposition. Put $A_X=p_X^*\underline\Omega$, where $p_X^*$ is the coefficient inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let $P$ be a sheaf of $A_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose there is a covering $\{V_\alpha\to X\}$ in $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] such that $P|_{V_\alpha}$ is the cokernel of a morphism $(A_{V_\alpha})^{m_\alpha}\to(A_{V_\alpha})^{n_\alpha}$ for finite nonnegative integers $m_\alpha,n_\alpha$, where $A_V=p_V^*\underline\Omega$ and restrictions use the composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback]. Then there exists a pro-etale covering $\{W_\beta\to X\}$ and finite nonnegative integers $r_\beta$ with $P|_{W_\beta}\cong(A_{W_\beta})^{r_\beta}$. This concerns ordinary sheaf cokernel presentations and imposes no derived completeness assumption.
